verdict.rationale: Antigravity has a dedicated headless CLI docs page for running the CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines and capture machine-readable output. That is backed by a Python Agent SDK exposing the same agent loop and cron-based Scheduled Tasks for autonomous background runs. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of headless flags, output formats and exit-code behavior, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of headless or CI usage.
